title_chain.summary_title: 宗教经验 religious experience (Mark Webb)
title_chain.zh_h1: 宗教经验 religious experience (Mark Webb)

spot.html_text: One further epistemological worry accompanies religious experience. James claimed that, while mystical experiences proved authoritative grounds for belief in the person experiencing them, they cannot give grounds for a person to whom the experience is reported. In other words, my experience is evidence for me, but not for you. Bovens (2012) gives a modern expansion and explanation of this claim. The claim can be understood in a variety of ways, depending on the kind of normativity that attaches
